scope: Presentation-only extension of the guarded single-cloud methodology specimen; not a replacement of the full Clean V1 weather workbench

implementation.lightProfiles: studio.js: five cloned presets and strict presentation-only parameter validation
implementation.lightControls: runtime.js: setLight, setLighting, setExposure, setRotation and setQuality; existing guard invoked
implementation.rendering: view.glsl: retained neutral formula, independent three-light studio transport and scalar volume diagnostics
implementation.export: runtime.js: original source state and effective profile hash, plus separate versioned presentation record

actualVisualInspection.source: Actual Chromium captures from workflow artifact 9786316374; no generated artwork used
observations: The same cloud silhouette is retained across the three inspected light presets.
Sunset lighting produces warm interior and edge colours.
Backlighting gives a visibly darker central region with brighter surrounding cloud edges.
Daylight interior contrast remains too shallow for a final AAA-quality claim.
Some outer wisps remain coarse or ragged; source morphology was intentionally not changed in this lighting-only task.
actualVisualInspection.interpretation: Functional lighting candidate with remaining visual refinement needs; not a visual pass

limits: Light power uses relative directional radiance and RGB conversion, without lux, Kelvin or spectral calibration.
Softness uses an angular cone and coarse optical-depth proxy; it is not a validated area-emitter or complete multiple-scattering solver.
This task adds no new cloud genera, weather dynamics or full-line migration.
SwiftShader tests do not verify frame rate on the user's GPU.
Inherited upstream Schema and validator provenance gaps remain unresolved.
